title.narrative: STREE- Social Transformation and Economic Empowerment of Women Artisans in India

description.narrative: Overall Objective: Empowering CSOs in taking up integration of design tools, digital manufacturing with traditional techniques leading to new paradigms for modelling and manufacturing of traditional handicrafts following fair trade principles and fulfilling the realization of SDG goals 1, 5, 12, 13, 15 and 17.Specific Objectives Creating livelihoods for women (including young girls) artisans engaged in traditional handicraft through computer assisted designing and fabrication of handicraft products, use of E commerce for last mile marketing, and public private partnershipSpecific Objective 2: Achieving supportive economic and trade policies for promotion of traditional handicraft items
